name: ai-game-studio-unity
description: An opt-in, pinned Unity MCP adapter and safety workflow for Codex AI Game Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and operate one pinned Unity MCP safely.
interface.longDescription: Detects Unity projects, plans the CoplayDev Unity MCP adapter, checks conflicts and permissions, and requires confirmation before setup or editor writes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-unity:setup-unity to inspect this Unity project and propose a pinned setup. Do not change anything yet.
